notes.title: Nature Campaign and Flight Campaign Released for Nature Demo
notes.content:
Time to go on Safari!  We just released the Nature Campaign, Flight Campaign, and new menus to the Nature Digital beta.   The campaign features new Challenges that change the rules and objectives of the game.  For example:

Worst to First:  Be in last place in the fourth round, then rally. 
Flock to it:  Take 4 eggs in one turn to get Gold.
Natural Population Growth (in Flight):  No Cards played to Population.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44420754/4c5d65a80f2fb0345ca0bc2f3c6cde96e926bd44.png[/img]

We've got tons of new levels and challenges, along with a new 3 star achievement system for each level.  The first 9 levels are free to try for non-backers.  Let us know what you think in Discord! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44420754/c29466727a0c781ae8674a4879843858c33af1bd.png[/img]
